observations: Seven variants, logical alignment, 80% width, 8px group gap and overlapping reactions were compared against the rendered reference.
Secondary remains subtly distinct from muted in both reference themes; the Flutter live-token mapping now preserves that relationship.
Interactive content exposes an exterior focus treatment and the reference transition is 150ms.

nativeChecks: All eight Bubble styleguide examples rendered without clipping or overflow.
Pointer activation produced deterministic local action feedback and a visible exterior focus ring.
Selected, disabled, busy and invalid content exposed distinct visual and accessibility states.
Static reactions announced once; interactive selection and failure changed counts, labels and error feedback.
Collapsible expanded the complete text and retained visible trigger focus.
Popover exposed the full command error and dismissed cleanly; Tooltip composition retained its independent read-receipt action.
Light, dark, Forest and Plum palettes retained readable semantic contrast.
360px width, 200% text, RTL and reduced-motion preview controls were exercised without overflow.
cleanup: The isolated app was quit, its reference tab was closed, and the unique bundle identifier was absent from the running-app inventory before releasing the desktop lease.
